_source: Updated 2026-10-12 from the Notion OFFER TRACKING parser run: 52 live partners; ceiling total 37334 published as $37,000+. Delta vs 2026-10-05 (51 / 37100): partner count 51 to 52 because vidIQ moved Pending to Live on 2026-10-07 with a $234 annual discount (50% off vidIQ Max year one), which is the entire +234 of value movement. The display string is unchanged at $37,000+ because both 37100 and 37334 floor to 37000. InstaClubHub (removed 2026-10-06, declined) and Hostinger Media (removed 2026-10-05, never replied) left the tracker from Pending and were never live, so they moved neither number. Zapier was added as a non-live onboarding row (draft, not partner-approved). total_value_exact is required - without it the widget stat tile silently falls back to the rounded figure. Uncapped-earn rows (ShopYourLikes, Insense, TopFan) count as live partners but their figures never enter the total. CreatorIQ is live with a one-time event ticket and contributes $0. Largest single discount remains $7,200 (CreatorCare). segments/segments_updated preserved untouched from the 2026-09-10 out-of-band write; they still reflect 50 partners and need their own refresh.
